entities.summary: Technical University of Cluj-Napoca is a public university located in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. It was founded in 1948, based on the older Industrial College (1920). The Technical University of Cluj-Napoca is classified by the Romanian Agency for Quality Assurance in Higher Education as an Advanced Education and Research University. The university is a member of the Romanian Alliance of Science and Technology Universities .
